Loader state transfer complete: server executes route loaders via the compiled routeLoader action subset (static-URL GET + responseJson, packages/plec-server/src/index.ts executeRouteLoader), publishes resolved/rejected outcomes keyed by loader_ref(graph_id, action) in the v2 snapshot (phase active/error), and renders loaderData via the loadHost host slot plus the error graph for rejections.
